# Interim Salary Increases for Staff Specialists - 2024 and 2025

Obsolete: This document is no longer current

Rescinded: This document is no longer current

## Summary

This Information Bulletin advises of a one year interim increase of 3% to remuneration rates commencing from the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2024 and a further one year interim increase of 3% on or after 1 July 2025 for staff specialists covered by the Staff Specialists (State) Award.

**Compliance with this policy directive is mandatory.**
